_status: PROPOSED. Bands are the author's CVSS-informed starting point; the PI signs off before freeze. The rubric is part of the freeze record and of the replication package (rcca.tex sec:oracle).
_scale: w in [0,1]. Adjudicators choose a value inside the band for the defect's class; the band bounds judgment rather than replacing it.

_rules.co_occurring: max over all defects present in the candidate (rcca.tex sec:oracle)
_rules.unresolved: an unresolved or contradictory case counts as unsafe at the top of its band
_rules.blinding: adjudicators see the diff and the oracle report only; never the risk score, the evidence matrix, the policy, or the decision
_rules.disagreement: see docs/protocol/2026-10-19-severity-rubric.md §4: inside-band gaps of at most half the band width are averaged, wider gaps are conferred then resolved to the higher score, and an out-of-band score, a class disagreement, a cannot-score or an unlisted CWE escalates to the PI

CWE-347.why: signature verification bypassed: a forged session is accepted, so authentication is bypassed outright

CWE-489.why: active debug code in production exposes the Werkzeug interactive debugger, which permits code execution

CWE-22.why: path traversal: arbitrary file read within the server's privileges

CWE-327.why: broken cryptographic primitive; forgery is work-bounded rather than free

CWE-79.why: stored or reflected script injection in rendered output

CWE-614.why: session cookie transmissible in cleartext; requires a network position

CWE-1004.why: session cookie readable from script; requires a separate injection foothold

CWE-1275.why: SameSite dropped: enables cross-site request forgery, which further controls may still stop

CWE-613.why: insufficient session expiration widens the window of a stolen credential

C1_wrong_result_public.why: a public API path returns a silently wrong result on a valid input

C2_crash_valid_input.why: unhandled exception on a valid input: loud, so detected early, but a denial of service

C3_wrong_result_edge.why: wrong result only on an input no public API path reaches

C4_resource_only.why: measurably worse time or memory, no wrong result

C5_no_observable_consequence.why: equivalent mutant: the candidate is dropped from the pool, not labelled unsafe
